title: Design System: Η εβδομάδα μου · ΤΗΜΜΥ

display.purpose: Two-line hero headline only; line-mask reveal.

print-event.purpose: Print only: course names in blocks.

print-meta.purpose: Print only: event times, rooms, day meta.

title.purpose: Panel headings: course rail, weekly schedule.

body.purpose: Default text, tabular figures; paragraphs at 1.6 line height.

control.purpose: Buttons, selects, menu items, season switch.

meta.purpose: Course meta, sync time, footer, tooltips.

shadows.name: lifted
shadows.purpose: Ink pills, season thumb, hovered event blocks, tooltips.

shadows.name: floating
shadows.purpose: Dialogs, menus, rail drawer, rail button.

shadows.name: highlight
shadows.purpose: Top-edge highlight paired with lifted and floating surfaces.

shadows.name: sheet-rise
shadows.purpose: Planner sheet top edge over the hero.

shadows.name: header-pill
shadows.purpose: Floating frosted header pill (with blur(20px) saturate(1.5)).

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: Default expo-out for transitions, entrances, drawers, dialogs.

motion.name: spring
motion.purpose: ~5% overshoot for things that land: odometer digits, season thumb, landed blocks. Falls back to the ease curve.

motion.name: control-state
motion.purpose: Colour, border and press transitions on controls; press is scale(.96).

motion.name: odometer
motion.purpose: Stat digits roll to new values (countTo).

motion.name: flight
motion.purpose: Added course flies on an arc from its rail swatch into each new slot (fly()); the ghost starts at a 3px corner (swatch-like) and opens to 10px in flight, then the block settles with the spring at +580ms. The 3px is a motion detail, not a radius token.

motion.name: season-turn
motion.value: out .3s cubic-bezier(.4,0,1,1), in .7s ease; rotateY 16deg, perspective 1600px
motion.purpose: Season switch turns the week via view transition, direction-aware.

motion.name: detail-morph
motion.purpose: Course dialog grows out of the clicked block or title (morphOpen()).

motion.name: hero-reveal
motion.value: line-in 1.2s ease, .1s/.19s stagger; sub and CTA fade-up at .42s/.54s; sheet-in 1.2s at .36s

motion.name: scroll-linked
motion.purpose: Hero copy lifts away over 60svh, header docks onto a solid bar, rail button rises as the sheet docks.

motion.name: scroll-morph
motion.value: e = smooth((p - .04) / .84); labels out e .35-.65; board/edges dissolve e .55-.95; slab tops to flat fill e .3-.9; planner chrome in e .82-.97 (--chrome); blocks crossfade p .9-1 (--blocks)
motion.purpose: Above 860px the fixed 3D stage (z 2, pointer-events none, clip-path path evenodd cutting the toolbar/stats band and docked rail) swings the camera straight down and lands the board on the live rect of the planner day columns; slabs flatten (y scale .03) and take the exact flat fill of their blocks (emissive = DOM fill; albedo, clearcoat and env drop). Docked: stage hidden, rendering stops. Reverses on scroll up. Phones: tilt-away under the sheet. Focus in the week or print forces the 2D week visible.

motion.name: free-view
motion.value: pointerdown catches (aim = current pose); held: yaw/pitch spring to aim (170/19); throw keeps spring velocity soft-limited by m*tanh(v/m) (m 12 yaw, 2.8 pitch; 0 under reduced motion), then drag exp(-dt*3.2) plus constant grip 2.6 rad/s^2 (flick 3 rad/s -> 32deg in .48s, 8 -> 95deg .70s, 16 -> 153deg .82s, 30 -> 177deg .87s); a thrown tilt stays within the same .1 rubber stretch (peak .098), never reaching the elevation clamp; yaw free; pitch [-.4, .86] on a .56 rad base, rubber band past it (STRETCH .1, asymptotic) with spring-back 160/18; camera elevation clamped [.06, pi/2-.04]; zoom eases to aim (120/18); zoom [.8, 1.6] by pinch or Ctrl+wheel; 5px drag threshold; double-click resets
motion.purpose: Hero board free view. Touch: horizontal swipes spin, vertical swipes scroll (.hero touch-action: pan-y pinch-zoom). Orbit springs home once scroll progress > 0 and its offsets scale by (1 - e), so the landing stays exact.

motion.name: free-view-feel
motion.value: lift .24 while dragging (95/15), one small settle on release (150/13); bank from yaw velocity (clamp .16) and nod from pitch velocity (clamp .12), 110/13; jelly lean rx/rz per slab 170/14 scaled by slab height and distance from centre; squash scale.y from lift velocity (clamp .14); all times calm (1 - e)
motion.purpose: Pseudo-physics weight on the hero board. Reduced motion: drag sets the pose directly, no throw, lift, settle or jelly.

motion.name: drawer-handoff
motion.purpose: Open tablet drawer or phone sheet: 3D stage hidden and not rendered (treated as docked); planner forced fully in (--chrome:1, --blocks:1, empty state opaque) so the fixed layer never draws over the drawer.

motion.name: copy-clearance
motion.value: spring pan; board quad >= 4px right of the copy box (12px above on phones); fades out as e rises
motion.purpose: Keeps headline, sub and CTA in front at any orbit or zoom; the home pose needs no pan.

motion.name: slab-height
motion.purpose: Slab height encodes weekly meetings n: once is nearly flat, three or more clearly tall.

motion.name: ring-trace
motion.purpose: Conflict trace pulses its red ring inward inside the block.

motion.name: smooth-scroll
motion.purpose: Page smooth scroll; nested scrollers and dialogs stay native.

motion.name: drawer
motion.purpose: Rail side drawer and phone bottom sheet; dialogs rise as sheets on phones.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Removes all CSS animation and transitions, view transitions, Lenis, fly/morph and the scroll morph; the 3D week is a still picture (.hero-stage.still) that scrolls away with the hero.

breakpoints.name: phone
breakpoints.purpose: max-width: vertical day agenda, rail as bottom sheet with scrim, dialogs as bottom sheets, 24px sheet radius, 3D tilt-away instead of the scroll morph.

breakpoints.name: tablet
breakpoints.purpose: Full-width week, rail as side drawer.

breakpoints.name: desktop
breakpoints.purpose: min-width: docked 340px rail beside the week.

breakpoints.name: lane-time-name
breakpoints.purpose: Narrow lane: start time plus the compact name, soft-hyphenated at Greek syllables (app.js hyphenate).

breakpoints.name: lane-time-code
breakpoints.value: 80px (container, screen); also lessons of an hour or less below 112px
breakpoints.purpose: Narrower lane: start time plus course code.

breakpoints.name: lane-number
breakpoints.purpose: Four or more parallel lessons: the shared ECE prefix hides, the course number stays.

narrative.overview:
The student's own timetable is a product shot. It sits as glossy 3D slabs on a floating board in a neutral photo studio, lit like an object on a seamless backdrop, and the planner sheet rises over it like a page slid onto the set. Everything around the object stays quiet: studio greys, ink type, one neon accent. The colour lives in the courses themselves.

Below the fold the studio becomes a calm, editorial work surface. The week is the canvas and is never cropped sideways. Pills for everything you press, soft 20-28px surfaces, 12px event blocks, giant grotesk numerals for the stats. The signature move is a scroll morph: on desktop and tablet the 3D board swings to a top-down view and lands exactly on the planner's week, and the slabs become its flat blocks. Elsewhere motion is physical and springy: things land with a small overshoot, digits roll, a course flies on an arc into its slot, and the season switch turns the week in 3D. Every one of these collapses to an instant, static path under reduced motion.

The world is modelled on butter.video, chosen by the user. Rejected and not to return: the cool-grey, electric-blue, pastel-course "premium product app" world set in Commissioner with 16/10 radii.
keyCharacteristics: Neutral studio greys with an off-white (light) or ink (dark) planner sheet; no tinted neutrals.
Ink is the primary action colour; hot pink is a single neon note, never a fill for large surfaces.
Nine vivid course hues, full-strength on event blocks, with ink or white text chosen by contrast.
Geologica everywhere, tabular figures by default, display sizes with tight negative tracking.
Pill controls, soft rectangles for surfaces, 12px for event blocks.
Soft layered shadows in light mode; hairlines take over in dark mode.
The hero's 3D week and the planner's 2D week are one object: scrolling morphs one into the other.
Spring motion with a ~5% overshoot; everything static under reduced motion.

rules.name: The One Neon Rule
rules.body: Hot pink is the only accent and it appears as small marks (a full stop, a day pill, a count, a hover), never as a button fill or a section background. Primary actions are ink.

rules.name: The Colour Is the Course Rule
rules.body: Saturation belongs to the course palette. Chrome stays grey and ink; no course is ever grey, and no course hue is pure green, amber or red, so courses can never be mistaken for a state.

rules.name: The Never Colour Alone Rule
rules.body: Every semantic state carries a second signal: passed is a filled green swatch plus a check icon; review is a dashed amber outline plus a hatch; overlap is a solid red outline plus a warning icon.

rules.name: The Numbers Are the Headline Rule
rules.body: Figures are tabular everywhere, and the week's totals are set at display scale, not tucked into small chips.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Geologica carries every role; hierarchy comes from size, weight and tracking, never from a second display face.

rules.name: The No Sideways Week Rule
rules.body: The week never scrolls horizontally. The grid is a 54px hour axis plus five equal day columns, whatever they hold. Parallel lessons split their day into lanes, and narrow lanes step down by container width. At 112px or less a lane shows its start time and the name, set compact with soft hyphens at Greek syllable breaks. At 80px or less, and for lessons of an hour or less, it shows start time plus course code. At 60px or less it shows the code only. At 50px or less the shared ECE prefix drops and only the course number remains. The full name always stays in the tooltip and dialog. Margin notes move beside the week only when the busiest day still gets 150px per lane.

rules.name: The Print Is Its Own Layout Rule
rules.body: Print is one A4 landscape sheet: chrome hidden, blocks at a 45% tint on white with ink text, the week scaled to fit and forced fully visible, the print type ramp, all motion and shadows off.

rules.name: The Press, Don't Lift Rule
rules.body: Controls press (scale 0.96 on active) and never rise on hover. Only event blocks lift (2px) on hover, because they are objects on the board.

rules.name: The Rings Inside Rule
rules.body: State and highlight outlines on event blocks sit inside the block (negative offset), never outside it.

rules.name: The Hairline in the Dark Rule
rules.body: In dark mode every raised surface (dialog, menu, tooltip, drawer, sheet) gets a 1px hairline edge, since shadows cannot read on ink.

dos: **Do** make primary actions ink pills; keep hot pink to small marks (full stop, today, counts, hover).
**Do** give every pressable thing a full pill shape and the 0.96 press.
**Do** let free-view interactions (orbit, zoom) yield to scroll and to the copy: plain wheel scrolls, the board springs home on scroll, and it never covers the headline.
**Do** pick block text colour by contrast (ink or white) for any course hue, including user-chosen ones.
**Do** pair every success, warning and danger state with an icon, dashes or an outline.

**Do** use the spring easing (`linear()` with ~5% overshoot, fallback cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)) for things that land, and make every animation, view transition, smooth scroll and 3D loop disappear under reduced motion.
**Do** keep five equal day columns and step narrow lanes down (time and name, time and code, code, number) rather than widening a busy day.
**Do** keep the week fully visible without horizontal scroll at every width, and keep print as a dedicated A4 landscape layout.
**Do** keep the 3D week and the planner's week the same object: same course colours, the same five equal columns and lanes, one hand-over sequence with never two hour axes on screen.
**Do** use tabular figures and display-scale numerals for the week's totals.
donts: **Don't** add a second accent colour or fill buttons, panels or headers with neon pink.
**Don't** use grey, pure green, amber or red as a course colour.
**Don't** introduce a second typeface or uppercase tracked labels; Geologica in sentence case carries every role.
**Don't** use square or small-radius buttons; nothing pressable sits between pill and rectangle.
**Don't** lift controls on hover or use hard offset shadows; controls press, only event blocks lift.
**Don't** draw state or highlight rings outside an event block.
**Don't** tint the neutrals cool or warm; the studio greys are neutral.
